Meta.title: Word Filter Plus
Meta.author: DK
Meta.description:
[h1]Word Filter Plus[/h1]
Extends Elin's distribution/stock word filters with three new token types:
[h2]Element matching — [code]@operator[/code][/h2] Matches items that have a given skill or element on them, exactly like the in-game Ctrl+F search. [code]@swimming[/code] — distributes all swimming-enchanted gear, regardless of identified state.
[h2]Rarity comparison — [code]rarity:OP rarity[/code][/h2] Filters by rarity tier using [code]= != > >= < <=[/code]. [code]rarity:>=Rare[/code] — distributes Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Artifact items. Rarity names (case-insensitive): Normal, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Artifact.
[h2]Identified predicate — [code]identified:true/false[/code][/h2] Restricts the filter to identified or unidentified items only. [code]identified:false[/code] — distributes only unidentified items.
[h2]Notes[/h2] [list] [*] All three token types can be mixed freely with each other and with plain name filters inside the same rule. [*] The existing filter behavior is unchanged when none of the new tokens are present — zero overhead on rules that don't use them. [*] Requires the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3413072131]Package Chainloader[/url] mod (FixedPackageLoader) to load correctly when installed from Workshop. [/list]
